headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when the AEW World Trios Titles had a new owner by the end of the night as The Elite vs. Death Triangle battled it out in an Escalera De La Muerte Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.54 ? a genuine showstealer ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In the deciding seventh match of the best-of-seven series, Kenny Omega climbed up and tore down the Trios Title belts himself to seal the win, crowning The Elite as two-time AEW World Trios Champions.

Back on this day in 2025, Daniel Garcia vs. Katsuyori Shibata clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.29 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. It was the 100th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In a hard-fought TNT Title defense against a legend of Japanese wrestling, Garcia caught Shibata off guard with a jackknife rollup to retain the championship.
It was 2023 when W. Morrissey was no more, reborn as Big Bill after 1 match, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when Adam Copeland left that name behind for good, stepping out as Cope after 23 matches under the old identity, on Collision.
2023 brought us this moment: Bryan Danielson vs. Konosuke Takeshita delivered a stone-cold classic on Dynamite, rated 8.57.
Looking back to 2023, when Adam Page vs. Jon Moxley delivered a genuinely great match on Dynamite, rated 8.37.
